# {{ person.name }}

> {{ person.job_title }} at {{ person.employer.name }} and PhD candidate in large-scale and non-convex portfolio optimization at the {{ person.affiliation.name }} (supervisor: Prof. Roy H. Kwon). Works on MIQP, MISOCP, non-convex QP and multi-period (MPC) portfolio problems, solved with ADMM-type heuristics and mixed-integer methods, applied to index tracking, risk parity and trading. Based in {{ person.location }}. Contact: {{ person.email_display }}.
